config:
# QLoRA on this Mac with MLX: a LoRA adapter on the 4-bit Qwen2.5-Coder 3B. Run: make ft-train
# Settings are mlx_lm's defaults except where a comment says why.
model: mlx-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-4bit   # the same 4-bit model as the experiment
train: true
data: finetune/data                 # train.jsonl / valid.jsonl from scripts/ft_filter.py
fine_tune_type: lora
mask_prompt: true                   # learn only the answer, not the 2.2k-token context
num_layers: 16
lora_parameters: {rank: 8, dropout: 0.0, scale: 20.0}
learning_rate: 1.0e-5
batch_size: 1                       # 16 GB of memory at ~2,300 tokens per example
grad_checkpoint: true
max_seq_length: 3072                # default 2048 would cut the answers off (longest example: 2,425 tokens)
iters: 400                          # about one pass over the 411 training pairs
steps_per_report: 20
steps_per_eval: 100                 # validation loss every 100 steps...
save_every: 100                     # ...with a checkpoint at the same steps; the lowest val loss is kept
val_batches: 25
adapter_path: finetune/adapters/qwen3b-qlora
seed: 0
